summary: Candidate is a distinct micro-skill for training hyperparameter adaptation (num_processes, per_device_train_batch_size) in pre_training_setup stage. It does not semantically overlap with existing skills (Mooncake checkpoint distribution, completion batch generation) which operate at different stages and task families. Peer candidates address model selection, comparative evaluation, and issue reporting—none of which conflict with or subsume this training config adjustment capability. The skill has clear support evidence from SimPO documentation and represents a standalone, actionable workflow.
